title: Catalog Insights
content_data:
> **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. A catalog is an asset that allows you to store information about the products you want to promote on TikTok. Using a catalog is a great solution for anyone who is looking for an efficient way to create and manage ads that feature a variety of products, like an online retailer. Catalog Insights API enables you to obtain insights about trending products in your catalog and trending catalog product categories on TikTok. See [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263078057986) and [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263100123137) to learn about the concepts and benefits of catalogs, and to find out how to create and manage catalogs. To learn how to access Catalog Product Insights, see [Obtain Catalog Product Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805642743426050). This group consists of the following endpoints: - [Get filters for catalog product insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805640864553985) - [Get trending catalog products](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805640886872066) - [Get trending catalog product categories](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805640900563969)
